natural: Living under another's fence

meaning.en: To live off others; to be dependent on someone else.
meaning.zh: 寄居在别人的篱笆下。比喻依附别人生活。

examples.zh: 他从小父母双亡，寄人篱下。
examples.en: Orphaned young, he grew up depending on others.

examples.zh: 她不愿寄人篱下，决定自己租房住。
examples.en: She didn't want to depend on anyone and decided to rent her own place.

story.en: Zhang Rong declared that a real man should create his own works, "why follow others and live under someone else's fence?"
story.zh: 张融说："丈夫当删诗书，制礼乐，何至因循寄人篱下？"

natural: All under heaven celebrating together

meaning.en: Universal celebration; everyone celebrates together.
meaning.zh: 天下的人共同庆祝。

examples.zh: 国庆佳节，普天同庆。
examples.en: National Day — the whole country celebrates together.

examples.zh: 新年到来，普天同庆。
examples.en: The New Year arrives amid celebrations everywhere.

natural: Horse-horse, tiger-tiger

meaning.en: Careless; also so-so, just passable.
meaning.zh: 形容做事不认真，不细心。也表示勉强、凑合。

examples.zh: 他做作业马马虎虎，错了很多。
examples.en: He does his homework carelessly and makes lots of mistakes.

examples.zh: ——你的中文怎么样？——马马虎虎。
examples.en: "How's your Chinese?" "So-so."

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Colloquial; as a reply it means "so-so". An idiomatic AABB.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，口语。也用作回答，表示"一般"。

natural: Knocking from the side, striking from the flank

meaning.en: To hint indirectly; to approach a subject obliquely.
meaning.zh: 比喻说话、写文章不从正面直接说明，而从侧面曲折地加以讽刺或抨击。

examples.zh: 妈妈旁敲侧击地问我有没有男朋友。
examples.en: Mum dropped hints trying to find out if I had a boyfriend.

examples.zh: 他不直接批评，而是旁敲侧击。
examples.en: Rather than criticise directly, he made pointed hints.

natural: Proud and self-satisfied

meaning.en: Arrogant and complacent.
meaning.zh: 自以为了不起，满足于已经取得的成绩。

examples.zh: 取得成绩后不能骄傲自满。
examples.en: Don't become complacent after success.

examples.zh: 他考了第一就骄傲自满起来。
examples.en: After coming top, he got cocky.

natural: Trailing mud and water

meaning.en: Sloppy and slow; not clean-cut.
meaning.zh: 比喻说话、写文章不简洁或做事不干脆。

examples.zh: 他做事从不拖泥带水。
examples.en: He never drags his feet.

examples.zh: 这篇文章拖泥带水，要精简。
examples.en: This essay is long-winded and needs tightening.

natural: Spring returns to the land

meaning.en: Spring returns; a revival after hard times.
meaning.zh: 春天又回到了大地。也比喻形势好转。

examples.zh: 春回大地，万物复苏。
examples.en: Spring returns and everything comes back to life.

examples.zh: 经济春回大地，市场重新活跃。
examples.en: The economy is thawing and the market is active again.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in New Year couplets.

natural: Forcing someone to do what's hard for them

meaning.en: To force someone to do something against their will.
meaning.zh: 勉强别人去做为难的事。

examples.zh: 他不想喝酒，你就别强人所难了。
examples.en: He doesn't want to drink — don't twist his arm.

examples.zh: 让新人一周完成这个项目，有点强人所难。
examples.en: Asking a newcomer to finish this project in a week is asking too much.

natural: Cruel at heart and vicious in hand

meaning.en: Ruthless and vicious.
meaning.zh: 心肠凶狠，手段毒辣。

examples.zh: 这个犯罪分子心狠手辣。
examples.en: The criminal is ruthless.

examples.zh: 商场上他心狠手辣，对手都怕他。
examples.en: In business he's merciless, and rivals fear him.

literal: eight · nine · not · far from · ten
natural: Eight or nine, never far from ten

meaning.en: Pretty much right; very close to the truth.
meaning.zh: 形容很接近实际情况，大致不差。

examples.zh: 你猜得八九不离十。
examples.en: Your guess is pretty much right.

examples.zh: 他会怎么说，我心里八九不离十。
examples.en: I've got a pretty good idea what he'll say.

natural: Not bound by small details

meaning.en: Not fussy about small matters; casual (sometimes careless) about etiquette.
meaning.zh: 不为小事所约束。多指不注意生活小事。

equivalents: not one to stand on ceremony

examples.zh: 他为人豪爽，不拘小节。
examples.en: He's open-handed and doesn't stand on ceremony.

examples.zh: 不拘小节也要注意基本礼貌。
examples.en: Being easy-going still requires basic manners.

usage.en: Predicate. Can praise generosity or criticise sloppiness.

natural: Heart settled and feet planted

meaning.en: Utterly devoted; dead set on something (often foolishly).
meaning.zh: 形容主意已定，决不改变。

examples.zh: 她死心塌地地爱着他。
examples.en: She's head over heels in love with him.

examples.zh: 他死心塌地地为老板卖命。
examples.en: He's utterly devoted to working himself to death for the boss.

usage.en: Adverbial. Can be neutral (loyalty) or critical (blind devotion).
usage.zh: 多作状语，可中性也可贬义。

natural: Coarse tea and plain rice

meaning.en: Simple, plain food; a frugal life.
meaning.zh: 粗糙的茶，清淡的饭。形容生活简朴。

examples.zh: 爷爷一辈子粗茶淡饭，身体很好。
examples.en: Grandpa has eaten simple food all his life and is very healthy.

examples.zh: 家里只有粗茶淡饭，请别嫌弃。
examples.en: It's just plain home cooking — I hope you don't mind.

usage.en: Subject or object. Often modest (offering food to guests).
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语，常用作谦辞。

pinyin: huà fǔ xiǔ wéi shén qí
natural: Turning the rotten into the marvellous

meaning.en: To turn something worthless into something wonderful.
meaning.zh: 把腐朽的东西变为神奇的东西。比喻变坏为好，变死板为灵巧。

equivalents: make a silk purse out of a sow's ear

examples.zh: 这位艺术家能化腐朽为神奇，用废品做出精美作品。
examples.en: The artist turns trash into treasure, making exquisite works from junk.

examples.zh: 好的编辑能化腐朽为神奇。
examples.en: A good editor can work magic.

story.en: Zhuangzi says all things are one breath of qi: "the rotten turns back into the marvellous, and the marvellous turns back into the rotten" (臭腐复化为神奇，神奇复化为臭腐).
story.zh: 《庄子·知北游》："臭腐复化为神奇，神奇复化为臭腐。"

natural: Wanting speed, you won't arrive

meaning.en: More haste, less speed.
meaning.zh: 想要求快，反而达不到目的。

equivalents: slow and steady wins the race

examples.zh: 学习要循序渐进，欲速则不达。
examples.en: Learn step by step — more haste, less speed.

examples.zh: 他急着完成任务，结果出了错，真是欲速则不达。
examples.en: He rushed the job and made mistakes — haste makes waste.

story.en: Confucius advised a disciple who had become a governor: "Don't seek speed, don't look for small gains. Seek speed and you won't arrive; look for small gains and great things won't be achieved."
story.zh: 子夏为莒父宰，问政。子曰："无欲速，无见小利。欲速则不达，见小利则大事不成。"

natural: Overbearing airs that ride over others

meaning.en: Arrogant and domineering.
meaning.zh: 以骄横的气势压人。

examples.zh: 他说话盛气凌人，同事都不喜欢他。
examples.en: He's so overbearing that his colleagues dislike him.

examples.zh: 大国不应该对小国盛气凌人。
examples.en: Big countries shouldn't be high-handed with small ones.

natural: Helping the tyrant Zhou in his cruelty

meaning.en: To aid and abet a villain.
meaning.zh: 帮助商纣王施行暴政。比喻帮助坏人干坏事。

examples.zh: 明知是诈骗还帮忙，就是助纣为虐。
examples.en: Helping knowing it's a scam is aiding and abetting.

examples.zh: 我们不能助纣为虐。
examples.en: We mustn't be complicit.

story.en: Zhang Liang warned Liu Bang not to indulge in Qin's palace luxuries, saying it would be "helping Jie in his cruelty" (助桀为虐) — Jie and Zhou being the archetypal tyrants.
story.zh: 张良劝刘邦："今始入秦，即安其乐，此所谓'助桀为虐'。"后多作"助纣为虐"。

usage.en: Predicate. 纣 is zhòu; 虐 is nüè.

natural: Dressing up faults and glossing over wrongs

meaning.en: To gloss over one's mistakes.
meaning.zh: 用漂亮的言辞掩饰自己的过错。

examples.zh: 犯了错就要承认，不要文过饰非。
examples.en: Admit your mistakes — don't gloss over them.

examples.zh: 这份报告文过饰非，回避了问题。
examples.en: The report whitewashes the problems.

story.en: Zixia said: "When a petty man makes a mistake, he is sure to dress it up" (小人之过也必文).

natural: The fox borrowing the tiger's might

meaning.en: To bully others by trading on a powerful patron's authority.
meaning.zh: 狐狸借老虎的威势吓跑百兽。比喻依仗别人的势力欺压人。

examples.zh: 他仗着是老板的亲戚，狐假虎威。
examples.en: Being the boss's relative, he throws his weight around.

examples.zh: 秘书狐假虎威，对下属指手画脚。
examples.en: The secretary bosses the staff around on borrowed authority.

story.en: A tiger caught a fox. The fox claimed Heaven had made it king of beasts and told the tiger to follow behind and watch. All the animals fled — from the tiger — and the tiger believed the fox.
story.zh: 老虎捉到狐狸，狐狸说自己是百兽之王，让老虎跟在后面看。百兽见了纷纷逃跑，老虎不知它们是怕自己。

natural: Leaving evil and returning to the right path

meaning.en: To turn over a new leaf; to reform.
meaning.zh: 从邪路上回到正路上来，不再做坏事。

examples.zh: 他出狱后改邪归正，成了一名志愿者。
examples.en: After prison he went straight and became a volunteer.

examples.zh: 给他一个改邪归正的机会吧。
examples.en: Give him a chance to turn over a new leaf.

natural: Scattered soldiers and roaming fighters

meaning.en: Stragglers; people acting individually without organisation.
meaning.zh: 原指没有统帅的逃散士兵。现比喻无组织的集体中独自行动的人。

examples.zh: 这些散兵游勇成不了大气候。
examples.en: These stragglers will never amount to much.

examples.zh: 市场上的散兵游勇正被大公司整合。
examples.en: Small independent players in the market are being absorbed by big firms.

natural: Each at a different end of the sky

meaning.en: Far apart from each other; living in different places.
meaning.zh: 各自在天的一边。形容相隔遥远，难以相见。

examples.zh: 毕业后同学们天各一方。
examples.en: After graduation, the classmates scattered to the four winds.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩天各一方，只能视频聊天。
examples.en: The couple live worlds apart and can only video-call.

natural: The ticket to victory in hand

meaning.en: Victory is assured; in the bag.
meaning.zh: 有把握取得胜利。

examples.zh: 领先二十分，主队已胜券在握。
examples.en: Twenty points ahead, the home team has it in the bag.

examples.zh: 别以为胜券在握就掉以轻心。
examples.en: Don't get careless just because victory seems certain.

natural: The nation's beauty and heaven's fragrance

meaning.en: Peerless beauty (originally of the peony, later of women).
meaning.zh: 原形容颜色和香气不同于一般花卉的牡丹花。后也形容女子的美丽。

examples.zh: 洛阳牡丹国色天香。
examples.en: Luoyang's peonies are breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.zh: 她是一位国色天香的美人。
examples.en: She's a woman of peerless beauty.

story.en: A Tang couplet on the peony: "Its national beauty flushes as if with morning wine; its heavenly fragrance perfumes clothes by night" (国色朝酣酒，天香夜染衣).
story.zh: 李正封咏牡丹："国色朝酣酒，天香夜染衣。"

natural: None before and none after

meaning.en: Unprecedented and unrepeatable; unique in history.
meaning.zh: 以前没有过，以后也不会有。

examples.zh: 这场演出的规模空前绝后。
examples.en: The scale of the performance was unprecedented and will never be repeated.

examples.zh: 他的成就可谓空前绝后。
examples.en: His achievements are unique in history.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常带夸张。
